windowHint.full: Window recordings get auto zoom, click highlights and the smooth cursor.
windowHint.effects: Window recordings get auto zoom and click highlights. The Windows cursor stays in the video, so there is no smooth cursor: native window capture is not available on this PC.
windowHint.moving: Moving the window is fine; a resized window is fitted into its starting size.
windowHint.none: Window recordings keep the Windows cursor in the video and have no auto zoom, click highlights or smooth cursor here. <link>Record an area instead</link> to get them.
warn.micMissing: The selected microphone is not connected, so the recording has no microphone.
warn.cameraMissing: The selected camera is not connected, so the recording has no camera.
unfinished.deleteQuestion: Delete this unfinished recording ({size})? This cannot be undone.
target.pickArea: Pick a screen, then drag out an area
sources.title: What to record
sources.areaHint: Click a screen, then drag over the part you want to record.
sources.noWindowsHint: Open the app you want to record, then refresh.
unfinished.title: Unfinished recordings
unfinished.intro: Footage that was kept when a recording did not finish. Recover it to edit it like any other recording.
unfinished.recoverTitle: Turn the saved footage into a project
library.title: Recent recordings
library.empty: Your recordings will show up here.
library.emptyHint: Pick what to record and press Start recording. Every recording opens in the editor and is saved automatically.
record.title: New recording
record.keysTitle: Records shortcuts such as Ctrl + C for the keystroke overlay, and when you type so auto zoom can follow your typing. Which keys you type is never recorded.
record.keysHint: Shortcuts and when you type, never which keys.
record.fps30: Lighter: half the frames to capture, encode and edit
record.stopHintKeys: Stop with the floating bar or <kbd>{keys}</kbd>.
finishLaterTitle: Keep the recording and convert it later from Unfinished recordings
cameraBubble.drag: Drag to move the camera to another corner
cameraBubble.hideTitle: Hide the camera bubble (show it again from the recording bar). The camera keeps recording.
regionPicker.drag: Drag to select the area to record
